title: B-tree pager cache, spill, and mmap limits

scope.rationale: Three adjacent B-tree wrappers serialize pager cache-size, spill-size, and mmap-limit configuration. Cache size replaces the suggested page count, spill zero queries without mutation and returns at least cache size, and mmap updates the requested mapping byte limit.

external_source_responsibilities: Pager/PCache application of limits and VFS mmap file-control transport
dependencies.caller_closure: All three B-tree configuration bodies and source-significant spill query semantics are assigned; pager/PCache/VFS effects remain integration boundaries.

inputs: Live Btree under owning connection mutex and signed cache/spill page values or mmap byte limit
outputs: Updated configuration state; spill returns max effective cache/spill size
contracts.state_and_results: Cache always replaces configured cache size. Spill zero leaves spill unchanged; nonzero replaces it; return is max(cache,spill). Mmap always replaces byte limit.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Source enters/leaves B-tree mutex and mmap may invoke VFS file control; model stores configuration while transport remains external.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: These wrappers return OK/no-error in source; model updates are infallible.

representation_differences: The Zig Shared owner records signed source configuration before integration with page_cache.Cache and VFS mmap control.
Negative spill byte conversion belongs to the existing page_cache.setConfiguredSpillSize owner and is not duplicated here.

oracle.protocol: Set cache 200, spill 300, query spill with zero, and set mmap 4096; compare persisted values and both spill results.
oracle.normalization: Signed configuration values and return are exact before pager transport.

assurance.oom: No wrapper allocation; PCache effects external.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: VFS mmap file-control and B-tree mutex integration remain external.
assurance.malformed_input: Signed values are retained for downstream source conversion.
assurance.performance: Constant-time state updates before downstream cache enforcement.

integration.native_call_path: Typed wrappers and source-significant state/query semantics are tested; page_cache/VFS transport remains pending.

independent_review.notes: Requires pager/PCache/VFS integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Connect mmap limit to Pager/VFS file control.
